faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Majuli Driver (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Driver (Contractual) post at DLSA Majuli is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed HSLC (High School Leaving Certificate) and possess a valid LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) driving license to be eligible for the Driver (Contractual) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Driver (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How much salary will be provided for the Driver (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 15,000 per month for the Driver (Contractual) position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Skill Test, specifically a Driving Test, followed by a Viva-Voce or Interview to assess the candidates' suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Majuli Driver (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Driver (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Driver (Contractual) in the District Legal Services Authority Majuli.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Majuli, which is https://majuli.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, which typically include your photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational/driving license certificates, as specified in the official notification.
